name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.12.8 prevents detailed visual descriptions from triggering avoidable search retries, improves product-card result recovery, and keeps product images inside verified cards instead of unreliable Markdown embeds. Results remain grouped into official-store, trusted-match, and best-value high-match options. Current deal checks use stable selected-product identity, current price, inventory, verified deal candidates, and optional delivered-price evidence; price-history and buy-or-wait forecasting are disabled. Authorized bounded Chrome search remains a user-approved fallback only after eligible API searches return no usable result. Search ranking remains independent of affiliate relationships. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
